test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select an appropriate tone of the passage.
solution:
The Correct answer is **'Objective and concerned.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage presents facts about the importance and rapid disappearance of wetlands. 
 
• It uses statistics to highlight the severity of the situation. 
 
• The language is neutral and focuses on delivering information. 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** 'Objective and concerned.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1)** Critical and cynical: This tone implies a negative and distrustful viewpoint.
 
• **Option 2)** Sarcastic and offensive: Sarcasm uses humor in a way that can be hurtful.
 
• **Option 4)** Pleading and indifferent: Pleading suggests begging or urging, while indifferent shows a lack of interest.
